prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 30.9 °C (within 1% of healthy); TS3 mean temperature 38.7 °C (within 1% of healthy). Operating temperatures and thermal gradient remain within optimal baseline specifications.
Valve: small lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.83 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.46 s (within 2% of healthy). Hydraulic valve exhibits slight transient lag while maintaining target pressure.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.40 l/min (3% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 400 W·min/l (4% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 55.8 % (5% below healthy). Motor draws full electrical power while circuit flow drops substantially, confirming internal fluid bypassing.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.1 bar (within 1% of healthy). Pressure buffering is largely ineffective due to compromised pre-charge pressure in the accumulator.
